twist_rules.description: The employee master table is renamed to 'anagrafica_lavoratori' in internal business documentation. All queries referencing this entity must use the alternate name, even though the physical table is 'dipendenti'. This rename affects all join conditions and WHERE clauses that reference this table.

The base salary column in the contracts table is commonly referred to as 'retribuzione_fissa' in business prose and reports. This synonym must be resolved when constructing conjunctive queries that filter or aggregate on compensation data, ensuring the logical business term maps to the actual physical column name.
